svg.title: Market roof and ramp columns at grade
svg.desc: Two plans at the same scale show the locations of the ground-bearing timber columns before and after the roof and walk frames were coordinated.

g.text: Market roof and ramp columns at grade
Fourth Avenue is at the left. Detroit Street cuts diagonally across the east ends of the stalls.
